overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long ARM Daily ETF (ARMG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of ARM Holdings stock, less fees, and expenses. ARMG was launched on Jan 14, 2025 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
